# S3 Tables runtime and broader metadata

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Define a coherent metadata-location and actual Iceberg file/runtime contract beyond the implemented customer metadata records.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] GetTableMetadataLocation
- [ ] UpdateTableMetadataLocation
- [ ] Genuine warehouse and metadata/data-file ownership with object reads/writes
- [ ] Iceberg REST catalog and query-engine integration
- [ ] Table schemas/nested types, partition specs and sort orders
- [ ] Maintenance, compaction, snapshots, expiration and replication
- [ ] AWS-managed buckets/tables and catalog analytics integrations
- [ ] Encryption/KMS/IAM execution and runtime readiness
- [ ] CloudFormation schema-backed Table, WarehouseLocation and advanced maintenance/encryption/storage/metrics/replication properties

## Integration decisions

Sixteen hierarchy/tag APIs and three finite CloudFormation resource subsets are implemented records only. See the [records guide](../../guides/s3tables-records.md). Metadata-location calls must not succeed until truthful file ownership and version semantics are implemented.
